Human sign-off is outside this isolated agent's authority; flagged for orchestrator. Technical criteria are met.

warnings: metric_honesty.py has a bypass: the heuristic 'if "target" not in low' whitelists the ENTIRE file when the substring 'target' appears anywhere. A dishonest report ('96% accuracy. Our target is X.') passed with exit 0. Recommend tightening: only treat a number as a target when 'target'/'aspirational' is adjacent to that number, not anywhere in the file. This is a guard-robustness gap, NOT a defect in the US-001 harness artifacts under certification.

pytest is not installed in the verification environment; the repo's own test file could not be run via pytest. Mitigated: this agent executed all four test functions directly (4/4 pass) AND re-derived every behavior with an independent script, so certification does not depend on the stored tests.

robustness_delta_pp is reported as a structured field and is correct, but the harness does not itself render a human 'headline string'; downstream report/deck generation must surface the cross-generator number + delta + curve (the report rendering layer is not in this US-001 package).
notes: Verdict by INSPECTION + INDEPENDENT RE-RUN (no prior run trusted). The harness correctly (1) refuses the circularity trap at manifest construction and on the dict-loader path; (2) refuses a headline when the held-out generator has no eval data (NoCrossGeneratorError); (3) makes the cross-generator recall + robustness delta + CI + ROC curve the headline, never an in-distribution point; (4) is config-driven and deterministic under seed. The harness EXPOSES the circularity gap (-83.5pp on a hard unseen C) rather than hiding it. No trained detector exists and none is claimed — correct for this gate. Overall PASS_WITH_WARNINGS: the artifacts under certification are sound; the single actionable warning is the metric_honesty.py 'target' substring bypass, which weakens (but does not nullify) honesty enforcement and should be fixed before the EPIC-DETECTION-API gate where real numbers will appear.
